composition_limitations: Explicitly selected formatter whose independent module fragments must retain their individual formatting when combined. Requires a no-op seed and a positive input/output example from bound native test source. Not applicable to whole-module sorting, context-dependent formatting, imports cleanup or semantic migrations. Exact output and AST checks are bounded examples, not a completeness proof.
applicability: Explicitly selected text transformer accepting valid Python in the running interpreter grammar. The caller supplies source-bound seeds and invocation. Not inferred from a project name or README.
oracle: Returned text must parse as Python. Generated input variants must preserve the seed AST.
limitations: Syntax preservation does not prove semantic equivalence, formatting correctness, support for every grammar version or completeness of acceptance.
fallback: Invalid seed, unsupported invocation or no applicable bracket variation is explicitly reported; retain native tests and request a different property or model review.
